evidence: Exhaustive search up to size 6 found optimal 4-set partition (arc-a through arc-d covering all 24 checkpoints). Standard greedy matched optimum. Randomized greedy across 12 seeds produced solutions ranging from size 4 to 6; seeds 1, 2, 4, 5, 11 chose splice sets early, fragmenting the partition and requiring 6 sets total.
statement: When interleaved sets fragment optimal partitions, greedy randomization degrades by picking splice or partial-overlap sets before recognizing full partition structure.
